info.title: Everpop API
info.description: Turn your own videos into published Shorts for YouTube, Instagram, Facebook and TikTok, with measured receipts on eligible YouTube Shorts. Built to be driven by AI agents: upload a file, clip it, publish it, and pull real 48h/7d performance — all by API. REST and MCP need the Pro or Scale plan; other accounts get HTTP 402 with reason subscription (no active subscription) or plan (the plan doesn't include API access). Full agent guide: https://everpop.app/skill.md · MCP connector: https://everpop.app/api/mcp/mcp (OAuth, or Authorization: Bearer epk_...)

x-changelog.changes: Changed: POST /api/v1/clip on a video whose strong moments were all clipped already completed FAILED with nothing new to clip; it now completes with one clip that reuses the best of them, flagged repeat_moment in qcWarnings. The first such render of a video in a month hands its video back, so GET /api/v1/usage does not count it. Automatic renders keep the old answer.

Changed: the upload size limit was 4 GB and is now 32 GB. POST /api/v1/videos/upload answered 413 file_too_large for a file over 4 GB; it now takes a file up to 5 GB, the most one PUT can carry. A file over 5 GB and up to 32 GB answers 413 file_too_large with reason single_put and browserUploadUrl: the user uploads it in the browser. A file over 32 GB still answers 413 file_too_large. Added: browserUploadUrl on that error body.

Changed: a 401 answered code unauthorized and now names its case: key_missing, key_invalid or key_expired. The Instagram posting-safety cap answered 429 rate_limited and now answers posting_cap. A 429 sent Retry-After: 60 whatever its cause; it now fits the cause (the seconds until resetsAt for quota_exhausted, 180 for queue_capacity, none for upload_cleanup_backlog, upload_retention_backlog and posting_cap, which carry retryable: false). A method a route does not support answered an empty 405; it now answers 405 method_not_allowed with an Allow header. Added: error bodies document their detail fields and a list of known codes (ErrorCode), including meta_publish_frozen. GET /api/v1/posts takes clipId. generateShort is marked deprecated while paused. Examples on the upload, finalize, clip, job, publish and receipts operations.

post.summary: Generate a vertical Short from a text prompt (paused: answers 403 reason=disabled)
post.description: Paused: returns 403 with reason=disabled (code=disabled) and creates nothing. Marked deprecated while paused; it may return. To make Shorts now, upload a file and call POST /api/v1/clip.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retries carrying the same key never mint a second metered render.

200.description: When enabled: render started — poll the returned job (1–3 min).

403.description: reason=disabled (code=disabled): prompt generation is paused and nothing was created. Also code=scope (read-only key) or code=suspended.

409.description: code=idempotency_conflict — the Idempotency-Key was already used with different options.

422.description: code=validation_failed — the body did not validate (issues says which field).

503.description: code=engine_offline — the clipping service is briefly unavailable; nothing was charged. Retry in a few minutes.

get.summary: List the user's source videos (detected uploads + API/dashboard uploads), newest first, 50 per page
get.description: Each video says whether it can be clipped (clippable) and, if not, why (notClippableReason — the code POST /api/v1/clip would return). Pages with an opaque cursor: pass the envelope's nextCursor back as ?cursor= until it is null.

422.description: Invalid limit, or code=invalid_cursor (pass nextCursor back unchanged).

post.summary: Step 1 of the compliant upload: get a presigned PUT for the user's video FILE
post.description: Everpop clips from the creator's file, never from a YouTube download. PUT exactly expectedBytes to the returned putUrl (15-min validity, ≤5 GB — the most one PUT can carry, files up to 32 GB go through browserUploadUrl — .mp4/.mov/.webm/.mkv/.m4v), send every requiredHeaders entry, and let the HTTP client supply Content-Length. Then call /api/v1/videos/complete. If the PUT times out or the connection drops, or a retried PUT answers 412 (If-None-Match: * means the bytes are already stored), call /api/v1/videos/complete with the same key before anything else: a 400 there means the bytes never landed (PUT again while putUrl is valid, else cancel the slot). At most 3 uploads can be open at once (429 upload_slots).

sizeBytes.description: Exact byte length bound into the signed upload request; one PUT carries at most 5 GB (a bigger file, up to 32 GB, goes through browserUploadUrl); files over 32 GB are not accepted on any path

data.next: PUT exactly expectedBytes of raw file data to putUrl with every requiredHeaders entry (Content-Length is supplied by the HTTP client), then POST /api/v1/videos/complete with { key, rightsConfirmed: true }. If you can't send file bytes, give the user browserUploadUrl instead (they sign in and upload there), then GET /api/v1/videos to continue; next time take the same link from GET /api/v1/videos, which opens no upload slot.

401.description: Missing, expired, or revoked API key.

402.description: Subscription or plan does not allow API upload.

403.description: Account verification, suspension, or write scope blocks upload.

409.description: Account deletion is in progress; no upload slot was opened.

413.description: code=file_too_large — files over 32 GB aren't accepted on any Everpop path (re-export smaller, or trim). With reason=single_put the file is over 5 GB, the most one PUT can carry: give the user browserUploadUrl (the dashboard uploader takes up to 32 GB).

422.description: Missing/invalid size or unsupported file type.

429.description: code=rate_limited: wait Retry-After (60). code=upload_slots: 3 uploads are already open — finalize or cancel one (a canceled slot counts until its 15-minute window ends), then retry. code=upload_cleanup_backlog or upload_retention_backlog (retryable: false, no Retry-After): earlier canceled uploads are still being cleaned up; stop and tell the user.

delete.summary: Cancel a failed or abandoned direct-upload slot
delete.description: Idempotent for a versioned key after terminal cleanup. A 503 cleanup_pending response means cleanup is durably recorded and will retry automatically. Never call this after successful or ambiguously acknowledged finalization.

200.description: Cancellation accepted or the versioned key was already cleaned.

401.description: Missing, expired, or revoked API key.

402.description: Subscription or plan does not allow API writes.

403.description: The key is not a versioned upload owned by this account.

409.description: The upload was finalized or a provider operation is still settling.

422.description: The cancellation payload or key is invalid.

503.description: reason=cleanup_pending: provider cleanup is durably queued and will retry automatically.

post.summary: Step 2: finalize the uploaded file into a clippable video (auto-clips for active plans)
post.description: rightsConfirmed must be the USER's attestation that they hold the rights — agents must ask, never assume. Pass linkSourceVideoId (a parked detected video from /videos) to attach the file to it: un-parks it and keeps its YouTube attribution. Idempotent per uploaded object. After an ambiguous PUT (timeout, dropped connection, or 412 on a retried PUT), call this with the same key first; cancel the slot only if it answers 400 (the bytes never landed).

rightsConfirmed.description: The user's explicit attestation; an agent must ask and may never infer this.

renderMode.description: auto: an account with automatic clipping on starts a render with its saved settings, and that render is this video's one monthly allowance. manual: no automatic render; pass it when you will call POST /api/v1/clip with your own options. The choice is durable — a retry that omits it keeps it.

200.description: Idempotent adoption result. autoClipping=true means a render is already running; parked=quota means the file is safe but monthly videos are used up.

400.description: The uploaded object is missing or empty: the PUT never landed. PUT again while putUrl is valid, else cancel the slot and start a new upload.

401.description: Missing, expired, or revoked API key.

402.description: Subscription or plan does not allow API writes.

403.description: Write scope, ownership, suspension, or the user's rights attestation blocks finalization.

409.description: Account/video deletion fence, secure deletion, or upload_not_ready settlement fence. Retry only upload_not_ready with the same key.

413.description: The stored object exceeds the 32 GB upload cap and is scheduled for secure cleanup.

422.description: The request body, key, title, or linkSourceVideoId is invalid.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded; replay the same key after Retry-After.

500.description: Ambiguous service failure; replay the same key and never upload/cancel the bytes again.

503.description: Ambiguous service failure; replay the same key and never upload/cancel the bytes again.

post.summary: Register a YouTube video's METADATA from the user's own connected channel (idempotent)
post.description: Metadata only — the video cannot be clipped until its file is uploaded (pair with /videos/upload + linkSourceVideoId).

200.description: The library video — browserUploadUrl is the sign-in-gated page where the user uploads this video's file (null once it has one).

400.description: No YouTube channel is connected to the account; the user connects one first.

403.description: The video belongs to a channel the user has not connected: import again with rightsConfirmed only if the USER confirms they hold the rights. Also code=scope (read-only key) or code=suspended.

404.description: The video is not on YouTube (deleted or private).

422.description: No YouTube video id in url, or the body did not validate.

502.description: code=upstream_error — YouTube credentials could not be refreshed or YouTube refused the request (the message says why); reconnecting the channel usually fixes it.

post.summary: Clip the best moments from one of the user's videos into vertical Shorts

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retries carrying the same key never mint a second metered render; reusing a key with different options is a 409 idempotency_conflict.

sourceVideoId.description: A video from GET /api/v1/videos with clippable: true.

prompt.description: Optional steer, e.g. 'the most surprising moment' — omit and the AI picks

clipCount.description: How many clips. Omit for the account's saved clip count (3 if unset). Capped by the plan's clips per video (Starter 3, Pro 10, Scale 15); the response's clipCountApplied says what the job runs with.

language.description: Omit to use the saved language choice (English text by default). Null explicitly selects English captions, headlines and hooks with auto-detected speech (non-English speech is translated). A lowercase ISO-639-1 code such as bg pins that spoken language and keeps text native — so en means the speech IS English; never send en for non-English speech. Original audio is retained.

archetype.description: Editorial cut; all = a Summary, a Top-moment and a Punch from one pass. Omit for the normal best-moments pick.

aspectRatio.description: The rendered frame. Omit for the account's saved setting (9:16 if unset). The response's aspectRatio says what the job renders at.

captionsEnabled.description: Burn captions into the clips. Omit for the account's saved setting (on if unset). The response's captionsEnabled says what the job applied.

value.prompt: the most surprising moment, ending on a cliffhanger

200.description: Render started — poll the returned job. clipCountApplied, aspectRatio and captionsEnabled are the values the job runs with.

404.description: Source video not found for this account.

409.description: code=idempotency_conflict — the Idempotency-Key was already used with different options.

429.description: code=rate_limited (Retry-After 60); code=quota_exhausted (monthly videos used up; retryable: false, Retry-After = seconds until resetsAt — tell the user); or code=queue_capacity (render queue full; retryable: true, Retry-After 180).

503.description: code=engine_offline — the clipping service is briefly unavailable; nothing was charged and the attempt is recorded as a failed job. Retry the same request in a few minutes.

get.summary: List the user's clip jobs, newest first, 20 per page — find the render finalize started
get.description: finalize starts the automatic render without returning a job id; list jobs for that video here (or read latestJob on GET /api/v1/videos rows). Pages with an opaque cursor.

parameters.name: sourceVideoId
parameters.description: Only jobs for this library video.

422.description: Invalid limit, or code=invalid_cursor (pass nextCursor back unchanged).

get.summary: List the user's posts (one per clip and destination), newest first, 20 per page — status on every platform
get.description: Per-destination publish status for YouTube, Instagram, Facebook and TikTok, the published URL, and the customer-facing reason when a post did not go out. Measured performance lives in GET /api/v1/receipts (eligible YouTube Shorts only).

parameters.name: clipId
parameters.description: Only this clip's posts — pass the clipId you published to follow each destination until its status is final.

422.description: Invalid limit, or code=invalid_cursor (pass nextCursor back unchanged).

get.summary: The account's plan, videos used and remaining this month, clips per video, capabilities, and whether finalize will auto-clip
get.description: Read this before planning a batch or starting a render: every clip job uses one video of the monthly allowance, except the first render of a video in a month whose only clip repeats a moment already clipped (qcWarnings flag repeat_moment), which hands its video back. Tell the user how many videos remain.

get.summary: Poll a generate/clip job — returns status and, when done, the produced clips

200.description: The job. Poll every 15–30s until status is not PENDING or PROCESSING.

review.hook: Nobody checks this, and it costs them

404.description: Job not found for this account.

get.summary: List the exact connected destinations available to this API key
get.description: Read this first and show the user the destination id, platform, and display name before requesting publish confirmation.

200.description: The exact destinations a publish may name.

post.summary: Publish a completed clip to explicitly named destinations (explicit user confirmation required)
post.description: Publishing is a real-world action. Before this call, show the user every exact destination, the final title/description, and visibility, then obtain an explicit go-ahead. Omitted destinations never mean all accounts.

200.description: One result per destination; ok:true only means the request was taken. Check every posts[].status and errorCode: PUBLISHED and DELIVERED went out, FAILED and CONFLICT did not, DISMISSED was discarded; the rest are still in flight — follow them with GET /api/v1/posts?clipId=. A post still in flight that carries errorMessage is held: relay the message to the user instead of polling it.

posts.errorMessage: This destination already has a publish with different reviewed choices. Refresh to see the active post before trying again.

403.description: reason=content_review — the clip is held for content review; or write scope/suspension.

404.description: reason=not_found — the clip does not exist for this account.

409.description: reason=clip_removed — the clip was removed from the library.

422.description: reason=unknown_destination (body.destinationIds lists ids that are not connected and healthy — nothing was published), no_eligible_destination (no requested destination can take this clip, e.g. a YouTube channel other than the clip source's), clip_not_ready, or rights_unconfirmed.

503.description: code=meta_publish_frozen: Instagram and Facebook publishing is paused for maintenance, and nothing in the request was published; retry after maintenance, or publish now without the Instagram and Facebook destinations. Otherwise a provider is temporarily unavailable; retry later.

429.description: code=rate_limited: wait Retry-After (60). code=posting_cap (retryable: false, no Retry-After): an Instagram destination is at its posting-safety cap for a rolling window of days; nothing was published — tell the user.

get.summary: Measured performance per published clip — real YouTube Analytics at 48h and 7d, newest first, 100 per page
get.description: Eligible YouTube Shorts published through Everpop, newest first. Pages with an opaque cursor: pass the envelope's nextCursor back as ?cursor= until it is null. A receipt may include a separately signed pre-publish prediction; measured metrics are not separately signed.

200.description: One page of receipts: aggregate YouTube Analytics metrics at 48h and 7d (views, retention as averageViewPercentage, likes, comments, shares and subscribers gained), each with its postId.

422.description: Invalid limit, or code=invalid_cursor (pass nextCursor back unchanged).

get.summary: List campaigns with post counts, measured views and the public payout-report link (Pro plan or above)

200.description: The account's campaigns with their post rollup and public report link.

402.description: reason=plan — campaigns are not included in this account's plan.

post.summary: Create a paid-clipping campaign (Pro plan or above)

sourceVideoId.description: The sponsor's footage in the user's library; posts published from its clips attach automatically.

sourceUrl.description: Link to the brief (stored, never fetched).

brief.description: Structured brief rules enforced on every attach.

404.description: sourceVideoId is not in the user's library.

422.description: The body did not validate, the brief could not be read, or both brief and notes were sent.

post.summary: Attach the user's published posts to a campaign (a post counts toward one campaign at a time)

postIds.description: postId values from GET /api/v1/receipts or the campaign proof.

403.description: A post id is not one of the user's published posts (named in the message).

404.description: Campaign not found for this account.

422.description: A post is not published yet, a post breaks the campaign's brief rules or the brief cannot be read, or the body did not validate.

get.summary: A campaign's measured payout report: per-clip 48h/7d numbers, totals, estimated payout and the public report link

parameters.name: csv
parameters.description: Any value returns a CSV download instead of JSON.

200.description: The payout report as JSON, or with ?csv a CSV download (one row per post).

404.description: Campaign not found for this account.

apiKey.description: Per-user API key from everpop.app/dashboard/api (Dashboard → API). Write scope required for mutating endpoints.

Envelope.description: Every response: { ok: true, data } on success, { ok: false, error, ...detail } on failure (the HTTP status carries the verdict).

clipCountApplied.description: The clip count the job runs with after the plan's per-video cap (1 for a Summary or Punch, which deliver one video).

aspectRatio.description: The aspect ratio the job renders at: the request's aspectRatio, or the account's saved setting when it was omitted.

captionsEnabled.description: Whether the job burns captions in: the request's captionsEnabled, or the account's saved setting when it was omitted.

clipId.description: The id POST /api/v1/publish takes (equal to id).

ClipReview.description: What to tell the user before asking them to confirm a publish. Clips with quality-check warnings can still be published by the user's explicit choice; mention the warnings.

qcWarnings.description: Owner-facing quality-check warnings; empty when the clip passed.

sourceStartSeconds.description: Where the clip starts in the source video, in seconds (null on older clips).

sourceEndSeconds.description: Where the clip ends in the source video, in seconds (null on older clips).

archetype.description: The editorial cut, e.g. top_moments, summary, punch.

hook.description: The words spoken in the clip's opening seconds, when recorded.

width.description: Rendered width in pixels, measured from the file (null when not measured).

height.description: Rendered height in pixels, measured from the file (null when not measured).

heldForReview.description: true when an earlier publish attempt left the clip held for content review (publishing answers 403 content_review until it is cleared).

flag.description: Stable machine key (e.g. profanity, dead_zone); _other for a flag without specific copy.

status.description: Stop polling on any status other than PENDING or PROCESSING.

error.description: Customer-safe failure detail when the job did not complete.

clipCountApplied.description: The clip count the job runs with after the plan's per-video cap (1 for a Summary or Punch).

clippable.description: Whether POST /api/v1/clip accepts this video — the same check the clip call runs.

notClippableReason.description: When clippable is false: the code POST /api/v1/clip would 422 with. upload_required = upload the file (POST /api/v1/videos/upload, then /complete with linkSourceVideoId = this id).

uploadUrl.description: When notClippableReason is upload_required: the sign-in-gated Everpop page where the user uploads this video's file (pre-attached to this video). Give it to the user when you can't send file bytes yourself. null otherwise.

latestJob.description: The newest clip job for this video (e.g. the automatic render finalize started), or null. Poll it with GET /api/v1/jobs/{jobId}.

used.description: Videos used in the current monthly window (every clip job counts as one; refunded failures don't).

resetsAt.description: When the monthly window resets (the billing day for paid plans).

clipsPerVideo.description: The cap applied to clipCount on POST /api/v1/clip.

destinationsConnected.description: Connected destinations whose grant is live (not waiting for a reconnect): the same set GET /api/v1/publish lists.

autoClipOnFinalize.description: Whether POST /api/v1/videos/complete (renderMode auto) starts a render right now: automatic clipping is on, the plan is active and videos remain.

error.description: Customer-safe failure detail when the job did not complete.
Customer-safe failure detail when the job did not complete.

clipCountApplied.description: The clip count the job runs with after the plan's per-video cap.

poll.description: Relative URL of the job, e.g. /api/v1/jobs/{id}

nextCursor.description: Pass back as ?cursor= for the next (older) page; null on the last page.

status.description: DELIVERED = in the creator's TikTok inbox as a draft; going public stays their tap.

error.description: The customer-facing reason a post did not go out (the same text the Posts page shows), at most 300 characters.

nextCursor.description: Pass back as ?cursor= for the next (older) page; null on the last page.

ReceiptWindow.description: Aggregate YouTube Analytics metrics for one measurement window.

averageViewPercentage.description: Average percentage of the Short viewed (retention).

h48.description: The 48-hour window, or null until it is measured.

d7.description: The 7-day window, or null until it is measured.

receiptUrl.description: Token-protected public receipt page, once the post has a measured window; null before.

campaignReportUrl.description: One token-protected link bundling the measured receipts on this page; null when none on the page is measured.

nextCursor.description: Pass back as ?cursor= for the next (older) page; null on the last page.
Pass back as ?cursor= for the next (older) page; null on the last page.

browserUploadUrl.description: The sign-in-gated Everpop page where the user uploads a new file themselves. Give it to the user when you can't send file bytes; unlike POST /api/v1/videos/upload it opens no upload slot.

videoId.description: A sourceVideoId for POST /api/v1/clip once the video's file is uploaded.

existing.description: true when the video was already in the library (the call is idempotent).

browserUploadUrl.description: The sign-in-gated page where the user uploads this video's file; null once it has one.

id.description: The id POST /api/v1/publish takes in destinationIds.

displayName.description: The connected account's name — show it to the user before they confirm.

destinations.description: Connected destinations whose grant is live (not waiting for a reconnect), oldest first.

status.description: This destination's post status after the call — one of the post statuses GET /api/v1/posts reports (e.g. PUBLISHING, QUEUED, FAILED) — or CONFLICT when the destination already has a publish of this clip with different reviewed choices (see errorCode). Follow later changes with GET /api/v1/posts.

currentStatus.description: When the call did not proceed because this destination already has a post for the clip: that post's status.

errorMessage.description: Customer-facing reason, when this destination did not proceed.

posts.description: One result per requested destination that took the clip. Idempotent per (clip, destination): a clip already published there returns its existing post.

sourceUrl.description: Link to the sponsor's brief — stored, never fetched.

sourceVideoId.description: The sponsor's footage in the user's library; posts published from its clips attach automatically.

notes.description: Free-text notes, or the stored form of structured brief rules (read brief / briefLines on GET /api/v1/campaigns instead).

CampaignListItem.description: Every Campaign field, plus the rollup of the campaign's published posts.

postCount.description: Published posts attached to the campaign.

verifiedViews.description: Measured YouTube Analytics views summed over the attached posts: per post the 7-day window when measured, else 48h (so a lower bound while 48h counts still climb).

measuredCount.description: Attached posts with at least one measured window.

estimatedPayoutCents.description: verifiedViews ÷ 1,000 × cpmCents, rounded; null without a CPM. An estimate — the marketplace's own view count governs payout.

rightsOk.description: Whether publishing from this footage is allowed (the user's rights attestation is on file).

brief.description: The structured brief rules enforced on every attach, or null.

briefLines.description: The brief rules as plain sentences.

briefUnreadable.description: true when stored brief rules could not be read (attaching refuses until they are fixed).

attached.description: Distinct posts attached (repeated ids count once).

platform.description: Only YouTube Shorts are measured; posts on other platforms carry no outcomes.

learnExclude.description: true when the post is excluded from learning: by the creator, or automatically when the Short went private or was deleted on YouTube, or because it is a Weekly Pop. Outcome capture skips it, so it gets no new measured windows.

briefLines.description: The brief rules every attached post passed.

items.description: The campaign's published posts, newest first.

verifiedViews.description: Measured views: per post the 7-day window when measured, else 48h.

estimatedPayoutCents.description: totals.verifiedViews ÷ 1,000 × cpmCents, rounded; null without a CPM. An estimate — the marketplace's own view count governs payout.

bundleUrl.description: One token-protected link to the measured receipts; null when none is measured.

ErrorCode.description: Codes an agent branches on, each explained in https://everpop.app/skill.md (Error codes). The list grows additively: handle a code that is not listed by its HTTP status.

error.description: Human-readable; safe to show the user.

reason.description: Kept for compatibility where it existed (e.g. subscription, plan, scope, unknown_destination, content_review). With code=file_too_large, single_put: the file is over 5 GB, the most one PUT can carry, and within the 32 GB limit.

code.description: Stable machine code, on every error: the specific code (e.g. upload_required, quota_exhausted, invalid_cursor, file_too_large), else the reason, else by status (bad_request, not_found, rate_limited, internal_error, …). Branch on this.

retryable.description: On some 429s. false (quota_exhausted, upload_cleanup_backlog, upload_retention_backlog, posting_cap): waiting a minute will not help; stop and tell the user. true (queue_capacity): retry after Retry-After.

issues.description: With code=validation_failed: the field errors ({ formErrors, fieldErrors }).

used.description: With code=quota_exhausted: videos (or AI shorts) used in the current window.

limit.description: With code=quota_exhausted: the plan's monthly allowance.

resetsAt.description: With code=quota_exhausted: when the allowance resets.

scope.description: With code=quota_exhausted: which allowance (videos or generations). With code=queue_capacity: whose queue is full (user or global).

destinationIds.description: With code=unknown_destination: the requested ids that are not connected and healthy.

uploadUrl.description: With code=upload_required: the sign-in-gated page where the user uploads this video's file.

browserUploadUrl.description: With code=file_too_large and reason=single_put: the sign-in-gated page where the user uploads the file (up to 32 GB).

The sign-in-gated Everpop upload page. If you can't send file bytes yourself, give this to the user instead, then list videos to continue. GET /api/v1/videos carries the same link without opening a slot, which counts against the user's open uploads until it expires.

renderMode.description: Present when this upload is held for a render the caller starts (renderMode manual).

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying: 60 for a per-minute rate limit (rate_limited, upload_slots), 180 for queue_capacity, the seconds until resetsAt for quota_exhausted. Absent on upload_cleanup_backlog, upload_retention_backlog and posting_cap, where waiting will not help soon.

Unauthorized.description: The API key did not authenticate. code=key_missing: no Authorization: Bearer epk_... header. code=key_invalid: the key is unknown or revoked. code=key_expired: the key passed its expiry; the user creates a new one in Dashboard → API.

PaymentRequired.description: REST and MCP need the Pro or Scale plan. reason=subscription: the account has no active subscription (subscribe, or redeem an invite code). reason=plan: the account's plan doesn't include this (API and agent access need Pro or Scale).

Forbidden.description: code=scope (also reason=scope): the API key is read-only and this is a write. code=suspended: the account is suspended. Endpoint-specific refusals document their own reason.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. code=rate_limited: the per-minute limit; wait Retry-After (60) seconds. code=quota_exhausted (with used, limit, resetsAt, retryable: false): the monthly allowance is used up; Retry-After is the seconds until resetsAt — tell the user rather than wait. code=queue_capacity (retryable: true): the render queue is full; retry after Retry-After (180).

UploadRequired.description: 422 with body.code: upload_required — this video's source is a YouTube URL and Everpop never downloads from YouTube; upload the file via POST /api/v1/videos/upload (+ /complete with linkSourceVideoId to attach it to this video), then clip. The body also carries uploadUrl, the sign-in-gated page where the user can upload the file themselves (for agents that can't send bytes). generated_source — a generated short's synthetic source (use /api/v1/generate). demo_source — Everpop's sample. validation_failed — the body did not validate. GET /api/v1/videos reports the first three ahead of time as clippable: false + notClippableReason.
